hero.headline: Every Voice Matters. Every Issue Has a Path to Action.
hero.subheadline: A secure, AI-assisted platform that helps citizens report public-service issues and helps constituency representatives identify patterns, prioritize urgent cases, and coordinate responsible action.
hero.disclaimer: Proposed civic-technology platform · Not an official government website

submit.title: Report a Public Issue
submit.subtitle: Secure & Anonymous Grievance Submission
submit.descPlaceholder: What happened? Where? When? Describe in as much detail as possible.
submit.successSub: Please save your Complaint ID to track status:
submit.successNote: Your complaint has been received. An AI-generated preliminary assessment will be generated and human review will follow. You are not required to provide your identity.
submit.anonymousNote: Your identity remains anonymous. AI will analyze the submission to assist human reviewers.
submit.aiDisclaimer: AI-generated preliminary assessment. Not a legal finding.

track.title: Track Your Complaint
track.subtitle: Enter your Complaint ID to check status
track.notFound: No complaint found with this ID. Please check and try again.

footer.disclaimer: This platform is a proposed civic-technology concept and is not an official government website unless formally authorized. AI-generated outputs are preliminary assessments only.
footer.builtFor: Built for Srikalahasti Assembly Constituency (No. 168), Tirupati District, Andhra Pradesh.

security.tagline1: Your complaint is visible only to authorized personnel assigned to review or act on it.
security.tagline2: Access is protected by authentication, role permissions and audit logging.
security.tagline3: Political branding does not control complaint priority, access or routing.
security.tagline4: Uploaded evidence is not publicly displayed.
